body:
Establishes the CPU double-CCF numerical reference requested in #262 and measures the complete 60-config, 600-run global/local DC factorial census. Against R, CPU/CUDA screen positives are 16/20 (none), 10/13 (global), 13/11 (local), and 0/0 (both); accepted sets match 60/60 in the both-conditioned arms. The README includes continuous errors, exact config/movie McNemar results, native first-divergence witnesses and the retained e10216-01 global failure.

Evidence-only under `docs/post_rc0/s1/dc_oracle/`. Diagnostic code is isolated on `diag/s1-dc-oracle` at native source `afba50a4`; default-off byte controls pass. Fixed-input double DC neutrality is within 1.71e-10 px; whole-movie local differences reach 4.27e-5 px through float state feedback. The largest conditioned residual and scientific-accuracy limitations remain explicit.

Validation: all 600 processes exited 0; five selected native CPU/CUDA checks passed; compact evidence verification passed and recomputed all 540 trajectory/field comparisons. The native archive is 0.83 MB; bulk products/maps/CCFs remain hash-bound in scratch. Full suites, controlled performance, motion truth and downstream science are unrun in this task. No merge requested.
